name: site-navigation
description:
## About Me Site Navigation
Reusable app-owned horizontal navigation for the About Me portfolio. Uses the shared near-black, warm ivory, muted zinc, and electric-lime editorial language through the core responsive navigation primitive.

### Inputs
- `activePage`: one of `home`, `about`, `work`, or `contact`; the matching destination receives the active check treatment.

The AM brand links to `/home`, and all destinations open in the current window.

children.name: Navigation
children.comments: Core navigation owns the responsive horizontal behavior and visual treatment. Active destinations use checkedWhen so the component remains reusable across all portfolio pages without duplicating route-specific markup. The Contact item remains a clear final CTA; the navigation primitive supplies its compact treatment consistently with the existing site language.

expressions.expression: [{label: 'Home', evaluateLabel: false, onClick: 'link', openIn: 'current-window', checkedWhen: "$ctrl.activePage === 'home'", link: {type: 'url', path: '/home', evaluate: false}}, {label: 'About', evaluateLabel: false, onClick: 'link', openIn: 'current-window', checkedWhen: "$ctrl.activePage === 'about'", link: {type: 'url', path: '/about', evaluate: false}}, {label: 'Work', evaluateLabel: false, onClick: 'link', openIn: 'current-window', checkedWhen: "$ctrl.activePage === 'work'", link: {type: 'url', path: '/work', evaluate: false}}, {label: 'Contact', evaluateLabel: false, onClick: 'link', openIn: 'current-window', checkedWhen: "$ctrl.activePage === 'contact'", link: {type: 'url', path: '/contact', evaluate: false}}]

bindings.name: activePage
bindings.description: Current portfolio page. The matching navigation item is visually marked as active. Accepted values: home, about, work, contact.
